effects.critical: Deux coups et deux éclats décalés de 160 ms ; six objets au lieu de trois pour une erreur critique.
effects.compatibility: Les anciens journaux sans effets choisis restent lisibles ; identités historiques conservées.

worker.runtime: real workerd through Miniflare, SQLite-backed Durable Objects
worker.quiz: 60 questions, serialized content larger than 128 KiB; bounded atomic KV chunks accepted by the real runtime
worker.authority: teacher key and room capabilities; learner cannot control host; original source IDs and future keys absent from learner view
worker.restart: new workerd instance restores quiz, capabilities, pause, answer key and scores from durable storage
worker.matching: Three-pair group retained after restart; an already associated word is rejected with HTTP 400; the next correct pair scores 2000 points in total; current key stays private
worker.transcripts: Two listeners and two questions on the same recording: no transcript in lobby, questions or first correction; final correction releases only the current text; stale pause refused; paused review text and scores survive a new SQLite runtime.
worker.wordClassification: Only neutral tokens and the target position reach learners; injected category tags are rejected; SQLite restart preserves the phrase and private grading.
worker.mascots: The common Leaf and new Kitsune identities join the real Worker, remain in the public roster and keep their scores after restart; no name or nickname supplied.

limits: Duels et tournoi sur écran commun ; synchronisation des duels sur les salles Internet encore ouverte.
Activation du service Internet de production à faire par l’administrateur ; aucun déploiement Cloudflare effectué.
Le jeu local fonctionne après préparation, dans la page ouverte ; démarrage à froid hors ligne non couvert.
Aucune nouvelle synthèse audio ni publication de configuration cloud.
